_comment: MCP Bridge configuration for connecting Copilot CLI to Claude Code
name: claude-bridge
description: Bridge to Claude Code for deep reasoning, architecture design, security analysis, and large-context code understanding. Leverages Claude's 200K token context window.
_note: command/args updated from the legacy `npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code --mcp` invocation to the standalone `claude` binary (`claude mcp`); verify the exact MCP subcommand with `claude --help` for your installed version.

tools.name: claude_reason
tools.description: Deep reasoning about code, architecture, and design decisions. Use when a task requires understanding complex interactions across the codebase.

question.description: The question or problem to reason about

context.description: Additional context (file contents, error messages, etc.)

tools.name: claude_architect
tools.description: Design system architecture and make structural decisions. Best for greenfield designs, refactoring plans, and migration strategies.

task.description: The architecture task (e.g., 'design a caching layer', 'plan microservice decomposition')

tools.name: claude_review
tools.description: Security-focused code review with deep analysis. Checks for vulnerabilities, logic errors, and architectural issues.

target.description: File path, directory, or diff to review

registration.note: Claude Code has native MCP server support — the `mcp` subcommand exposes its tools directly

prerequisites: claude (standalone Claude Code CLI binary installed and on PATH)
